summary_zh: PdfCraft 是一款用纯 Rust 从零编写的开源 PDF 阅读与编辑工具，可用于阅读、整理、合并、拆分和加密 PDF，支持搜索选中复制、页面组织、表单、图层、批注与附件，并提供命令行工具。
audience_zh: 适合需要在 macOS、Windows、Linux、FreeBSD 或网页上阅读和编辑 PDF 的普通用户，也适合偏好离线、无账号无遥测、重视原生性能与开源引擎的开发者及技术用户。

evidence.quote: PdfCraft: An open-source PDF reader and editor written from scratch in pure Rust
Read, organize, combine, split and secure PDFs in a fast, native app, written in Rust from the ground up.
macOS · Windows · Linux · FreeBSD · the web
No account, no telemetry, no cloud. It works offline and opens instantly. The engine, CLI and app are all open source.
